referenceFunction.generalComment: The volume refers to the wood not including the bark. CO2 assimilation is based on 49.4% carbon in the dry wood including the bark (10%). Biomass energy equals the gross calorific value of softwood including the bark. Data on the land use and the dry density are specific for the Korporation Giswil, which delivers the wood to Walter Küng AG for the production of holzpur elements. Land use type changed to "forest, intensive" (original: "forest, intensive, normal") for differentiation of use intensity in the KBOB recommendation 2016 (project 563).; UUID: 1db6c58f-440f-3e84-9537-8d6a565ed1d0
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Includes CO2 absorption from air and the land use for trees to grow. Forest road area is not included in the land use.
